digest.component_or_area: rebar Jira Data Center transport layer
propositions: DC rate limiting (admin-enabled in 8.6+) sends 429 responses with Retry-After headers that rebar's transport does not honour, causing hard failures on rate-limited instances

429 retries cannot be scoped to all call sites because _with_connection_retry is the single choke point for mutations including create_issue, and retrying after a 429 can reintroduce the duplicate-issue defect if the server already began the write
The retry/error cluster in transport.py (789 LOC) cannot be extended with 429 policy in place due to locked 800-line cap with only 11 lines headroom
429 retry logic must reuse existing _errors.parse_retry_after and MAX_BACKOFF_S, apply jitter then clamp per Atlassian guidance, and be gated by per-call opt-in defaulting to OFF
All 15 transport call sites must be examined to determine which are idempotent reads eligible for 429 retry versus mutations that must fail-fast on first 429
